strings: This module contains duplicated code from Python itself or 3rd party
extensions, which may be included for the following reasons:
* we may only need a small subset of the copied library/module
This module is deprecated since 1.26.0 and will be removed in future versions.
u`np.compat`, which was used during the Python 2 to 3 transition, is deprecated since 1.26.0, and will be removed
